panels.title: Light on-time per day (hours)
panels.description: Intervals with value > 0 between consecutive event rows, per local day. Without the exterior outputs and the stair steps.

targets.rawQueryText:
-- hours on per local day, from events
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
days(d0, d1) AS (
  SELECT s, CAST(strftime('%s', date(s, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', '+1 day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) FROM (SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(q.f, 'unixepoch', 'localtime'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS s FROM q)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d1, CAST(strftime('%s', date(d1, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', '+1 day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) FROM days, q WHERE d1 < q.t
),
ev AS (
  SELECT CASE v.name WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_LOFT_WEST' THEN 'Loft west' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_LOFT_EAST_1' THEN 'Loft east 1' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_LOFT_EAST_2' THEN 'Loft east 2' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_BEDROOM_SOUTH' THEN 'Bedroom south' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_BEDROOM_NORTH' THEN 'Bedroom north' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_BATHROOM' THEN 'Bathroom' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_STAIRS' THEN 'Stairs' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_HALLWAY' THEN 'Hallway' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_LIVING_ROOM' THEN 'Living room' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_DINING_ROOM' THEN 'Dining room' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_KITCHEN' THEN 'Kitchen' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_WASHBASIN' THEN 'Washbasin' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_KITCHEN_COUNTER' THEN 'Kitchen counter' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_KOLARNA' THEN 'Bike shed' WHEN 'ST_LIGHT_SKLEP' THEN 'Cellar' ELSE v.name END AS name, x.ts, x.value, LEAD(x.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.var_id ORDER BY x.ts) AS te
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN events x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts < q.t
       AND x.ts >= COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.ts) FROM events e WHERE e.var_id = v.id
                              AND e.ts <= (SELECT MIN(d0) FROM days)), 0)
  WHERE v.name IN ('ST_LIGHT_LOFT_WEST', 'ST_LIGHT_LOFT_EAST_1', 'ST_LIGHT_LOFT_EAST_2', 'ST_LIGHT_BEDROOM_SOUTH', 'ST_LIGHT_BEDROOM_NORTH', 'ST_LIGHT_BATHROOM', 'ST_LIGHT_STAIRS', 'ST_LIGHT_HALLWAY', 'ST_LIGHT_LIVING_ROOM', 'ST_LIGHT_DINING_ROOM', 'ST_LIGHT_KITCHEN', 'ST_LIGHT_WASHBASIN', 'ST_LIGHT_KITCHEN_COUNTER', 'ST_LIGHT_KOLARNA', 'ST_LIGHT_SKLEP')
),
iv AS (
  SELECT name, ts, COALESCE(te, MIN(q.t, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER))) AS te FROM ev, q WHERE value > 0
)
SELECT d.d0 AS time, iv.name, SUM(MIN(iv.te, d.d1) - MAX(iv.ts, d.d0)) / 3600.0 AS value
FROM days d JOIN iv ON iv.ts < d.d1 AND iv.te > d.d0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
